title: Bar Ada the Surveyor
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He was in charge of measuring land in Rava’s days, as in Eruvin 56b: Rava said, “Bar Ada the surveyor explained it to me.” Hyman considers him undoubtedly the one mentioned in Bava Metzia 107b: Rav Yehudah said to Rav Ada the surveyor, “Be careful,” etc.; Dikdukei Soferim cites from a manuscript of the Rif “Ada the surveyor.” Hyman infers that in Rav Yehudah’s days he was still young, and in Rava’s days he was an old man advanced in years, who explained [things] to Rava.

notes.text: The consulted Eruvin 56b has Bar Ada the surveyor, while Bava Metzia 107b has Rav Ada the surveyor. Their identification and the inference about his age remain Hyman’s; the exact Rif manuscript reading reported through Dikdukei Soferim has not been inspected.
